changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.4 stability-recovery test build restores the user-validated 2.0.1.1 playback/runtime baseline, removes the experimental Android Record dispatcher introduced in 2.0.1.2-2.0.1.3, and makes Edit, Clone Channel and Delete use the exact same compact sizing rule as Generate New Schedule. Standard TV streaming, Personalized TV, scheduling and Guide geometry are otherwise unchanged.
